data.subject: Strengthen your writing with Gemini
data.body: Draft, edit, and get feedback on your writing in one focused space. ======================================================= A smarter way to refine your essays Use Gemini to draft papers and get constructive feedback to help strengthen your arguments. Find what you need : https://gemini.google.com/app/download/mobile?android-min-version=301356232&ios-min-version=322.0&is_sa=1&campaign_id=writing_stu_hero_autosubmit&utm_source=gemini&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=writing_stu_hero_autosubmit&pt=9008&mt=8&ct=writing_stu_hero&prompt_id=cviUWFRYxt3Y&prompt_action=autosubmit
